title: 通过一致性驱动强化学习提升跨语言事实回忆能力
summary: 提出PolyFact数据集（100K Wikidata事实，12种语言），对比CPT、SFT和GRPO三种方法提升LLM跨语言事实回忆。GRPO优于SFT，能提高跨语言一致性和对未见语言的泛化能力，机制分析表明GRPO通过减少MLP层和注意力头的语言专门化来重组多语言路由。
summary_en: Introduces PolyFact, a 100K Wikidata-grounded multilingual QA dataset across 12 languages. Compares CPT, SFT, and GRPO for improving cross-lingual factual recall. GRPO outperforms SFT, enhancing consistency and generalization to unseen languages. Mechanistic analysis shows GRPO reorganizes multilingual routing by reducing language specialization.
